summary: Household of 4 with about $192,000/year in earned income (about $16,000/month). That is well above the income limits for SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC and free or reduced-price school meals. It is also above the 400% FPL cap (about $128k for 4) for the ACA premium tax credit now that the enhanced subsidies have expired. The refundable part of the child tax credit is unlikely to apply because their tax liability should absorb the credit. No programmes recommended.
